title: I'm making a game with Claud, and I released a demo on Steam today
author: Prujinkin
selftext:
Hey reddit people!  
  
My coolest dev/Claude part is the system for finding the board settings that produce the most interesting matches and for first-turn balance.

To do that I created a "drama index" to "score" of how "thrilling" a match was.   
It counts: lead changes, the biggest comeback the winner pulled off, supply-line cuts, captured chunks of the opponent's territory, bomb chains, etc.

I already had bots with three different difficulty levels. And Сlaude wrote an agent that ran bot-vs-bot matches on the live server while sweeping all the board setting: size, bomb count, Lloyd relaxation, grid density contrast hunting for the settings leading to the the highest drama.   
The tuning sweeps alone were \~20,000 matches and these results formed the basis for the presets in the game.

Same scheme for first-move advantage: I added a small nuance to how crystals spawn around the second player, and the agent tuned it across all bot difficulties. Result: the first player now wins 49.8% (the first-move edge is gone).

Today the first Reddit players came in, and the most dramatic human match scored a 53-turn game where the lead flipped back and forth until the very end)

It's great to finally **have the demo up** on Steam!)  
And I can't imagine doing all this without Claude.  
  
There's a demo on the web: [https://play.crystalwars.io/](https://play.crystalwars.io/)  
(no login or download required)   
and a demo on Steam [https://store.steampowered.com/app/4810920/Crystal\_Wars/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4810920/Crystal_Wars/)
